Cardiac Physician in Meerut: Dr. Gurjeet Singh Gill Answers Your Heart Health Questions

Namaste, main Dr. Gurjeet Singh Gill hoon, cardiac physician at Gill Heart Clinic, Mohiuddinpur, Meerut. Aaj main aapke dil ki baat karunga – literally! Heart disease India mein tezi se badh raha hai, aur Meerut jaise shehron mein bhi log cardiac problems se peedit ho rahe hain. Lekin sahi jankari aur samay par ilaaj se aap apne dil ko swasth rakh sakte hain. Is blog mein main aapke kuch common sawaalon ke jawab de raha hoon, jo mere paas Meerut aur aas-paas ke patients sabse zyada poochte hain. Toh chaliye shuru karte hain.

❓ Patient Question: "Doctor sahab, heart attack ke warning signs kya hain? Main kaise pata karun ki mujhe heart attack aa raha hai?"

🩺 Dr. Gill's Answer: Dekhiye, heart attack ke warning signs ko pehchanna bahut zaroori hai kyunki har minute matter karta hai. Sabse common symptom hai chest pain – aapko seene ke beech mein dabav, bhaaripan ya jalan mehsoos ho sakti hai. Ye pain aapke left arm, jaw, neck, ya peeth tak ja sakta hai. Kuch logon ko saans phoolne ki shikayat hoti hai, pasina aata hai, chakkar aate hain, ya ulti jaisa mann hota hai. Lekin khaas baat ye hai ki mahilaon, diabetics aur buzurgon mein symptoms alag ho sakte hain – jaise sirf thakan, pet mein gadbad, ya saans phoolna. Agar aapko aise symptoms 5 minute se zyada feel ho rahe hain, toh turant 108 ambulance call karein ya nearest hospital jayein. Aur haan, aspirin 325 mg chabana chahiye agar aapko allergy nahi hai. Lekin yaad rakhein, yeh first aid hai, doctor se checkup karwana zaroori hai. Meerut mein Gill Heart Clinic par hum 24/7 emergency services provide karte hain.

❓ Patient Question: "Doctor, kya heart attack aur cardiac arrest same hote hain? Mujhe confusion hai."

🩺 Dr. Gill's Answer: Nahi, yeh dono alag hain. Heart attack (myocardial infarction) tab hota hai jab dil ki muscle ko blood supply karne wali artery block ho jati hai, jisse heart muscle damage ho jata hai. Cardiac arrest tab hota hai jab dil achanak dhakna band kar deta hai, jisse blood circulation ruk jata hai. Heart attack ke baad cardiac arrest ho sakta hai, lekin har heart attack se cardiac arrest nahi hota. Cardiac arrest ke liye CPR (cardiopulmonary resuscitation) aur defibrillator ki zaroorat hoti hai. Isliye, main hamesha kehta hoon ki har kisi ko CPR ki basic training leni chahiye. Meerut mein humne kai logon ko CPR sikhaya hai. Aur agar aapko chest pain ho raha hai, toh usse ignore na karein – yeh heart attack ka pehla sign ho sakta hai. Sahi samay par ilaaj se heart attack ke damage ko kam kiya ja sakta hai.

❓ Patient Question: "Kya cholesterol badhne se heart disease hoti hai? Mere reports mein LDL high hai, main kya karun?"

🩺 Dr. Gill's Answer: Ji haan, high LDL cholesterol heart disease ka ek bada risk factor hai. Framingham Heart Study jaise landmark trials ne saabit kiya hai ki cholesterol levels aur heart attack ke beech seedha sambandh hai. LDL ko 'bad cholesterol' kehte hain kyunki yeh arteries mein plaque banata hai, jisse blockages ho sakte hain. Agar aapka LDL 100 mg/dL se zyada hai, toh aapko lifestyle changes aur zaroorat padne par medicines ki aavashyakta ho sakti hai. Indian diet mein ghee, butter, fried foods, aur processed snacks se bachein. Iske badle mein oats, nuts, fruits, vegetables, aur whole grains khayein. Exercise rozana 30 minutes karein. Agar aapko diabetes ya high BP bhi hai, toh aapka target LDL 70 mg/dL se kam hona chahiye. Statins jaise medicines doctor ki salah par lein. PM Jan Aushadhi stores par generic statins sasti aur effective milti hain. Meerut mein Gill Heart Clinic par hum lipid profile test aur personalized treatment plan dete hain.

❓ Patient Question: "Doctor, main 45 saal ka hoon aur mujhe high BP hai. Kya mujhe heart attack ka khatra hai?"

🩺 Dr. Gill's Answer: High BP (hypertension) ko 'silent killer' kaha jata hai kyunki yeh bina kisi symptom ke dil, kidney, aur brain ko nuksan pahunchata hai. Aapki age aur BP ke saath, heart attack ka risk badh jata hai. Lekin ghabrayein nahi, isko control kiya ja sakta hai. SPRINT Trial 2015 ke mutabiq, BP ko 120/80 mm Hg se neeche rakhne se heart attack aur stroke ka risk kam hota hai. Aapko regular BP check karwana chahiye, kam namak khana chahiye (5g se kam), potassium-rich foods jaise kela, palak, aur nariyal pani lena chahiye. Exercise, weight control, aur stress management bhi zaroori hai. Agar lifestyle se control nahi hota, toh doctor aapko medicines de sakte hain. PM Jan Aushadhi par generic antihypertensives sasti milti hain. Meerut mein Gill Heart Clinic par hum aapka BP monitor karte hain aur sahi ilaaj dete hain.

❓ Patient Question: "Kya diabetes se heart disease hoti hai? Mera sugar 200 hai, main kaise bachav karun?"

🩺 Dr. Gill's Answer: Diabetes heart disease ka ek major risk factor hai. High blood sugar arteries ko damage karta hai aur cholesterol ko badhata hai. Aapka sugar 200 mg/dL hai, jo bahut zyada hai. Aapko turant doctor se milna chahiye. Diabetes control karne ke liye diet, exercise, aur medicines zaroori hain. Indian diet mein chawal, roti, aur mithai se bachein. Iske badle mein dal, sabzi, salad, aur low-glycemic foods khayein. Rozana 30 minutes walk karein. Metformin jaise generic medicines PM Jan Aushadhi par sasti milti hain. ISCHEMIA Trial 2020 ke mutabiq, diabetes patients mein heart disease ka early detection aur treatment zaroori hai. Meerut mein Gill Heart Clinic par hum diabetes aur heart disease dono ka comprehensive management karte hain.

❓ Patient Question: "Doctor, heart ke liye best diet kya hai? Kya main ghee kha sakta hoon?"

🩺 Dr. Gill's Answer: Heart-healthy diet mein fruits, vegetables, whole grains, lean proteins, aur healthy fats shamil hain. Ghee ko completely band karne ki zaroorat nahi, lekin limit karein – 1-2 chammach rozana tak. Indian diet mein badi problem hai refined oils, trans fats, aur excess salt. Iske badle mein mustard oil, olive oil, aur desi ghee ka istemal karein. Fried foods, packaged snacks, aur cold drinks se bachein. AHA guidelines ke mutabiq, saturated fat total calories ka 5-6% se kam hona chahiye. Aur haan, fiber-rich foods jaise dal, rajma, oats, aur fruits zaroor khayein. Ye LDL cholesterol kam karte hain. Dr. Eugene Braunwald, jo duniya ke top cardiologist hain, hamesha kehte hain ki diet aur exercise heart disease ke 80% risk ko kam kar sakte hain. Meerut mein hum patients ko personalized diet chart dete hain.

🩺 Dr. Gill's Clinical Experience

Gill Heart Clinic, Mohiuddinpur, Meerut mein maine hazaaron patients ko treat kiya hai. Ek 52 saal ke businessman the, unhe chest pain aur sweating thi. Unki ECG aur troponin test se heart attack confirm hua. Humne turant angioplasty ki aur unki jaan bach gayi. Aaj woh bilkul theek hain aur regular checkup karwate hain. Ek aur case: 38 saal ki mahila, jinko sirf thakan aur saans phoolne ki shikayat thi. Unhe diabetes aur high BP tha. Humne unka lipid profile check kiya, LDL 180 tha. Humne lifestyle changes aur statin shuru ki. 6 mahine mein unka LDL 70 ho gaya. Yeh cases dikhate hain ki samay par sahi diagnosis aur ilaaj se kya farak padta hai. Meerut mein log aksar late aate hain, lekin awareness badh rahi hai.

Indian-Specific Diet and Lifestyle Advice

Heart health ke liye Indian diet mein yeh badlav karein:

  • Namak kam karein: 5g se kam rozana. Pickles, papad, aur processed foods se bachein.
  • Healthy fats: Mustard oil, olive oil, aur desi ghee (limited). Trans fats se bachein.
  • Fiber: Dal, rajma, chana, oats, aur fruits khayein.
  • Exercise: Rozana 30 minutes brisk walk, yoga, ya cycling.
  • Stress management: Meditation, deep breathing, aur acchi neend.
  • PM Jan Aushadhi: Generic medicines jaise statins, antihypertensives, aur antidiabetics sasti aur effective hain. Meerut mein Jan Aushadhi store se lein.

FAQ

Q: Kya heart attack ke baad normal life ji sakti hai?

A: Bilkul! Sahi ilaaj, diet, exercise, aur regular checkup se aap normal life ji sakte hain. Dr. Valentin Fuster kehte hain ki cardiac rehabilitation se recovery better hoti hai.

Q: Kya mujhe angioplasty ki zaroorat hai?

A: Yeh aapke blockages aur symptoms par depend karta hai. ISCHEMIA Trial 2020 ke mutabiq, stable patients mein medicines se bhi utna hi fayda hota hai jitna angioplasty se. Lekin emergency mein angioplasty zaroori hai.

Q: Kya heart checkup ke liye khaali pet aana zaroori hai?

A: Haan, lipid profile aur sugar test ke liye 8-10 ghante ka fasting zaroori hai. BP aur ECG ke liye fasting ki zaroorat nahi.

Q: Kya main heart specialist se kab milun?

A: Agar aapko chest pain, saans phoolna, dhadkan tez hona, ya risk factors jaise diabetes, high BP, high cholesterol, ya family history hai, toh turant cardiac physician se milein.
